intro_heading: Food that brings two families together
intro: Engagement functions in Vellore range from fifty relatives at home to a full hall with a stage. We scale the menu to your function: a traditional leaf lunch, an evening tiffin with sweets and snacks, or a dinner buffet after the ring ceremony.
We also pack sweet and savoury boxes for the thambulam and for guests to take home, so your family does not have to place a separate sweet shop order.

faqs: Can you cater an engagement function at home?
Yes. For home functions we bring the cooked food, serving ware and our team, and we can cook on site if there is space.
Do you prepare sweet boxes for the engagement?
Yes. We prepare sweet and savoury boxes in the quantity you need. Tell us the count when you book.
Can we have a veg lunch and a non-veg dinner?
Yes. Many families keep the ceremony meal vegetarian and serve non-veg at dinner. We cook the two in separate batches.
